name: Atlantic County, NJ
findings: Atlantic County has 1,000 nonprofit organizations. 370 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 281 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Atlantic County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Union organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 16 union organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do union organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 76 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 76 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few youth organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 4 youth organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 10 would.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
